what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Eritrea, as counted by IDMC for 2009 to 2014.
IDMC's figure for people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence stayed at 10000 from 2009 to 2014; UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2014.
Refugees from Eritrea live mostly in Ethiopia, Sudan, Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Djibouti and Eritrea in 2008, and between Eritrea and Ethiopia in 2016.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Eritrea in IDMC's data.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2014, the only years with an IDMC figure.
The fact pack has no figure for later years.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC's year-end figure counts people still displaced; it does not record how they moved.
